title: UK Space Agency announces Unlocking Space for Defence and National Security programme
excerpt: The programme supports organisations working across civil and defence space by addressing identified barriers.
bodyHtml:
The UK Space Agency announced the Unlocking Space for Defence and National Security programme on October 13, 2026. The programme supports UK organisations to unlock growth through civil-defence space opportunities.

The programme supports the growth of organisations working across civil and defence space by addressing barriers identified through engagement with the space sector. It also works by strengthening alignment across government, defence and national security stakeholders.

The programme has been developed based on engagement with the space sector to identify barriers for organisations aiming to operate across civil and defence space. This development occurred alongside cross-government alignment to map overlapping priorities and capability needs.

The UK Space Agency stated that the programme supports organisations working across civil and defence space by addressing barriers identified through engagement with the space sector and by strengthening alignment across government, defence and national security stakeholders.
